children: Halifax, Nova Scotia--(Newsfile Corp. - November 26, 2026) - Torrent Capital Ltd.

("Torrent" or the "Company") today provided its October 2026 portfolio update and estimated Net Asset Value ("NAV"). As at October 31, 2026, the Company reported an estimated NAV of $26.3 million, or approximately $0.69 per share.
August Portfolio Performance Highlights
Net Asset Value:
Approximately $26.3 million, or $0.69 per share, as at October 31, 2026, compared with approximately $28.6 million, or $0.75 per share, as at September 30, 2026.
Cash and Cash Equivalents
: Torrent had $7.3 million in cash and cash equivalents as at October 31, 2026, compared with $4.7 million as at September 30, 2026.
Market weakness in October, which has persisted into November, has weighed on our portfolio valuations
," said Wade Dawe, Chief Executive Officer of Torrent Capital Ltd. "
We remain focused on the long-term fundamentals of our investments and the opportunities emerging from this period of market volatility.
NAV per share and all per-share figures are calculated based on common shares outstanding at the applicable reporting dates. The number of common shares outstanding may vary between periods.
Cautionary Note on Preliminary Results

The October 2026 financial information presented in this press release is preliminary and unaudited and is subject to change following the completion of the Company's standard closing procedures and review. Final October results will be included in the Company's audited financial statements and MD&A for the year ended December 31, 2026, that will be filed on SEDAR+ on or before April 30, 2027.
About Torrent Capital Ltd.

Torrent Capital is a publicly traded Investment Issuer that actively manages a portfolio of public equities and private investments. The Company invests in companies that are expected to experience accelerated growth or are trading at a discount to their intrinsic value. Torrent offers investors the potential to earn above-market returns while providing transparency, daily liquidity and a modest fee profile compared with competing investment products.
For further information, please contact:
Wade Dawe
Chief Executive Officer
